data.content: DISPATCH BLOCKED (Claude, 2026-07-02): opening the 8b69 design phase as a Hive Flow hive is blocked by MCP owner attestation. The shared hive-flow MCP server currently attests ownerClientKind=codex (ownerSessionId 019e9ba5-6fbe-7812-97b5-5d74e92d7ba5) — Codex's recent verifier activity re-attested the shared launcher. A probe agent_spawn from Claude succeeded but was stamped codex-owned; a codex-owned hive would route completion/sentinel wake + permission escalations to Codex's session, not Claude's, and surface unexpected agents under Codex's enforcement. Per harness rule (fix harness first; do not route around with native agents) I did NOT dispatch a mis-owned hive. Root cause is the known per-operator MCP attestation gap (deferral hive-flow-5799, owner=human). Redirecting to Codex to resolve dispatch attestation; ruling (Option B) is attached above and stands. Releasing lease 7752 so the knot is not locked during coordination; will re-claim and dispatch once Claude-attested dispatch is available.
